name: hyper-ai
description: Review and improve the AI agents of your Hyper workspace: their configuration, demos, leads and change history, and edit and publish them.

interface.longDescription:
Hyper runs AI agents that give live, voice-led product demos to your prospects and guide your new users through your app. Connect your Hyper workspace to see how your agents perform and improve them from ChatGPT.

What you can do:
- See your agents and their full configuration: prompt, demo route, lead form, qualification questions, smart links and branding.
- Review demos: transcripts, scores, blockers, next steps and the funnel, and search what prospects say across many demos (objections, integrations, competitors).
- See your leads and their qualification answers.
- Change an agent's prompt, demo route, lead form, qualification questions, smart links or branding, publish it, or copy it into another language. Every change is recorded in the agent's Logs with who made it and from where.

Who it is for: teams that use Hyper (gethyper.ai) for sales demos or user onboarding.

Limitations: it needs a Hyper account. You only see the workspaces your account belongs to, and changes need an editor role. It cannot create agents from scratch, delete them, run demos, contact leads or change billing. Prompt changes reach the live voice agent only after you publish.
capabilities: Edit prompts, demo route, lead form, questions, links and branding
Publish agents and copy them into another language
defaultPrompt: How did my Hyper agent's demos go this week, and what should I fix?
What objections do prospects raise in my demos?
What changed in my agent recently?

positive.description: List the agents of the connected workspace
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the four agents of the test workspace (Sigma - Sales Agent, Hyper AI - Sandbox, Retell AI Demo, Plinng - ES) with their type, language, status and last demo.

positive.prompt: How did the last demo of Retell AI Demo go?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the latest demo of Retell AI Demo (October 30, 2026, about 2.5 minutes, score 45) and summarizes it from its transcript and analysis: what was shown, the blockers (pricing never discussed, no timeline, the prospect left before the tour ended) and suggested next steps, citing the demo id.

positive.prompt: Give me the funnel and the most common blockers for Sigma - Sales Agent.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the agent's funnel (links opened, conversations started, demos over 1 and 5 minutes), why demos ended early, the average score and the recurring blockers, such as pricing not discussed and no next steps.

positive.prompt: In Hyper AI - Sandbox, change the first message to: "Hi! I'm Max from Hyper. Want to see how an AI agent runs a live demo?"
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the agent, shows the current first message next to the new one, and saves it once the user agrees. Confirms the change with its Logs reference (LOG-…) and explains that it reaches the live voice agent only after the agent is published.

positive.prompt: What changed in Hyper AI - Sandbox recently?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the recent changes newest first, each with its LOG- reference, date, who made it and from where (including the edit made through this connector), and the field before and after.

negative.description: Deleting an agent is not supported

negative.prompt: Show me the demos of the agents of another company that uses Hyper.
Email everyone who had a demo last week with a discount offer.

review.commerce_description: Hyper does not sell products or process payments through ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: read agents, demos, insights, leads and change history; edit, publish and copy agents into another language.

es-ES.subtitle: Gestiona tus agentes de demo
es-ES.description:
Hyper ejecuta agentes de IA que dan demos de producto en directo, por voz, a tus prospectos y guían a tus nuevos usuarios por tu aplicación. Conecta tu workspace de Hyper para ver cómo rinden tus agentes y mejorarlos desde ChatGPT.

Qué puedes hacer:
- Ver tus agentes y toda su configuración: prompt, recorrido de la demo, formulario, preguntas de cualificación, enlaces y marca.
- Revisar demos: transcripciones, puntuación, bloqueos, siguientes pasos y el embudo, y buscar lo que dicen los prospectos en muchas demos (objeciones, integraciones, competidores).
- Ver tus leads y sus respuestas de cualificación.
- Cambiar el prompt, el recorrido, el formulario, las preguntas, los enlaces o la marca de un agente, publicarlo o copiarlo a otro idioma. Cada cambio queda en los Logs del agente, con quién lo hizo y desde dónde.

Para quién: equipos que usan Hyper (gethyper.ai) para demos de venta u onboarding de usuarios.

Límites: necesitas una cuenta de Hyper. Solo ves los workspaces de tu cuenta y para cambiar algo necesitas rol de editor. No crea agentes desde cero, no los borra, no lanza demos, no contacta a leads ni cambia la facturación. Los cambios del prompt llegan al agente de voz cuando lo publicas.
